actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger every 2-3 days
Water thoroughly until it drains, then empty saucer after 30 minutes
Move plant away from heater airflow
Set up pebble tray with water for humidity
Alternatively group with other plants for humidity
If still limp after a week, slide out of pot and inspect roots
If root-bound, repot into a pot 2 inches wider

reason: The answer names underwatering as the main cause and its core advice to water thoroughly matches the fix that worked, and its soil-check safeguard keeps it from being harmful.
